reason: An experimental DSH plugin for A/B testing context re-anchoring after compaction by rebuilding model-visible history, restoring handoff state, and staging tool availability across epochs.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中测试上下文压缩后通过重建模型可见历史和分阶段开放工具来进行 Epoch 重锚定实验的插件。
summaries.en: An experimental DeepSeek Harness plugin for testing epoch re-anchoring after compaction by rebuilding model-visible history and staging tool availability.

capabilities: Rebuilds model-visible conversation history after compaction
Creates epoch-based handoff messages and restores selected recent records
Controls staged availability of bootstrap and standard tools
Installs and removes DSH preset files
Applies epoch behavior to eligible fresh local child agents
